source: Hand-written from 15-provider-driver.md §2.7, §4.5, §4.10 and §6, the ACP schema of @agentclientprotocol/sdk 1.6.0 (the pinned client) and the codex-acp sources at cxacp@bf37821 (read only: src/AgentMode.ts for the session modes, src/CodexAcpServer.ts for initialize, docs/permission-extension.md for the option set); no adapter or CLI was run, and codex-acp is not installed on any machine that wrote these files. The cases are ported from the hand-written Claude acp synthetic set (../../../claude/acp/2.1.x-synthetic/), since both drivers share the generic ACP client (15 §4.10): agentInfo names codex-acp, the session modes are the three codex-acp 1.13.1 reports (read-only, agent, agent-full-access; recorded in ../0.153.4/, where the pinned read-only is the on-request preset), tool calls carry no name (the card shows the ACP kind), and every permission option carries its native Codex decision in _meta.codex.decision. 0.157.x is the @openai/codex range codex-acp 1.13.1 depends on; the driver always pins CODEX_PATH to the person's own codex instead. The cases a recording covers (launch, second turn, allow, deny, interrupt, resume, close) were removed here: they live in ../0.153.4/, recorded against codex-acp 1.13.1 on Windows (real-CLI lane, 17 §5.5; TC-153-01).

capabilities.adapter: @agentclientprotocol/codex-acp (user-installed until S-008-1 has a bundle row for it)
capabilities.pinnedMode: read-only (Ask for approval in codex-acp 1.13.1: approvalPolicy on-request, approvalsReviewer user, workspace-write sandbox); agent (auto_review) and agent-full-access (approvalPolicy never) auto-approve and are never kept
capabilities.note: the 15 §3 row X2 design values as CodexAcpDriver reports them: question none and mcpInjection none (U→none), subagents none, usage fidelity 1 without rate limits

thirdParty.source: agentclientprotocol/codex-acp (cxacp) at bf37821, src/__tests__/CodexACPAgent/data/approval-command-allow-once.json, approval-file-change.json and approval-permissions-request.json
thirdParty.changes: copied under a cxacp- prefix with the same JSON values (whitespace normalised by the repository formatter); the -with-extra variants are DwarfAI additions
thirdParty.note: The adapter's own requestPermission calls (its test fixtures, not ACP traffic DwarfAI recorded): the reference option sets for the Deny mapping (decline preferred, else reject_once), read by denyMapping.test.ts.
